global:
  name: free5gc
  # Selects the SMF and UPF topology; no chart files need to be copied.
  userPlaneArchitecture: ulcl  # supported values: "single" and "ulcl"
  uesubnet: 10.60.0.0/16  # UE IP address pool

      name: nrf-nnrf
      type: ClusterIP
      port: "8000"
      nodePort: "30800"
  sbi:
    scheme: http

  amf:
    multus:
      enabled: false  # Default: disabled for cloud-native deployments
      n2if:  # NGAP interface (used when multus.enabled=true)
        ipAddress: 10.100.50.249
      n2network:

        port: 38412

#
# Software Name : towards5gs-helm
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2021 Orange
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#
# This software is distributed under the Apache License 2.0,
# the text of which is available at todo
# or see the "LICENSE" file for more details.
#
# Author: Abderaouf KHICHANE, Ilhem FAJJARI, Ayoub BOUSSELMI
# Software description: An open-source project providing Helm charts to deploy 5G components (Core + RAN) on top of Kubernetes
#
# Default values for ueransim-chart.
# This is a YAML-formatted file.
# Declare variables to be passed into your templates.

global:
  free5gcReleaseName: free5gc-helm  # Name of the free5gc helm release
  gnb:
    multus:
      enabled: false
      n2network:
        enabled: true
        name: n2network
        type: ipvlan
        masterIf: eth0
        subnetIP: 10.100.50.248
        cidr: 29
        gatewayIP: 10.100.50.254
        excludeIP: 10.100.50.254
      n3network:
        enabled: true
        name: n3network
        type: ipvlan
        masterIf: eth0
        subnetIP: 10.100.50.232
        cidr: 29
        gatewayIP: 10.100.50.238
        excludeIP: 10.100.50.238


projectName: ueransim

initcontainers:
  sctp_test:
    image: towards5gs/sctp_test
    tag: latest

gnb:
  enabled: true
  name: gnb
  replicaCount: 1
  image:
    name: free5gc/ueransim
    tag: v4.0.1
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  configmap:
    name: gnb-configmap
  volume:
    name: gnb-volume
    mount: /ueransim/config
  service:
    name: gnb-service
    type: ClusterIP
    port: 4997
    protocol: UDP

  n2if:  # NGAP
    ipAddress: 10.100.50.250
  n3if:  # GTP-U
    ipAddress: 10.100.50.236

  amf:
    n2if:  # NGAP
      ipAddress: 10.100.50.249
      serviceName: free5gc-amf-amf-n2
      port: 38412
    service:
      ngap:
        enabled: false

  podAnnotations: {}
    # additional annotations
  imagePullSecrets: []
  podSecurityContext: {}
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: 100m
      memory: 256Mi
  nodeSelector: {}
  tolerations: []
  affinity: {}

  configuration: |-
    mcc: '208' # Mobile Country Code value
    mnc: '93'  # Mobile Network Code value (2 or 3 digits)
    nci: '0x000000010'  # NR Cell Identity (36-bit)
    idLength: 32        # NR gNB ID length in bits [22...32]
    tac: 1     # Tracking Area Code
    # List of supported S-NSSAIs by this gNB
    slices:
      - sst: 0x1
        sd: 0x010203
    # Indicates whether or not SCTP stream number errors should be ignored.
    ignoreStreamIds: true
ue:
  enabled: true
  name: ue
  replicaCount: 1
  image:
    name: free5gc/ueransim
    tag: v4.0.1
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  configmap:
    name: ue-configmap
  volume:
    name: ue-volume
    mount: /ueransim/config
  command: "./nr-ue -c ./config/ue-config.yaml"  # This is the command that will be launched in the UE container
  # A script that will be run after the UE creation. It may be used to periodically generate traffic
----
# free5gc Helm chart

This is a Helm chart for deploying the [free5GC](https://github.com/free5gc/free5gc) on Kubernetes. It can be used to deploy the following Helm charts:
 - [free5gc-amf](./charts/free5gc-amf)
 - [free5gc-ausf](./charts/free5gc-ausf)
 - [free5gc-n3iwf](./charts/free5gc-n3iwf)
 - [free5gc-nrf](./charts/free5gc-nrf)
 - [free5gc-nssf](./charts/free5gc-nssf)
 - [free5gc-pcf](./charts/free5gc-pcf)
 - [free5gc-smf](./charts/free5gc-smf)

containers. Each chart can override the value through its `podSecurityContext`;
the UPF chart has separate values for `upf`, `iupf1`, `psaupf1`, and `psaupf2`.

 - A Kubernetes cluster ready to use with all worker nodes using kernel `5.0.0-23-generic` and they should contain gtp5g kernel module.

If you are using an older version of Kubernetes please refer to this [link](https://v1-19.docs.kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/#sctp) to enbale SCTP support.

### Verify the kernel version on worker nodes

```console
uname -r
```

If you don't have a Persistent Volume provisioner, you can use the following commands to create a namespace for the project and a [Persistent Volume](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/persistent-volumes/) within this namespace that will be consumed by MongoDB by adapting it to your implementation (you have to replace `worker1` by the name of the node and `/home/vagrant/kubedata` by the right directory on this node in which you want to persist the MongoDB data).
```console

cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolume
metadata:
  name: example-local-pv9
  labels:
    project: free5gc

  capacity:

  persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy: Retain
```

```console
helm -n <namespace> install <release-name> ./free5gc/
```

```console
kubectl -n <namespace> get pods -l "project=free5gc"
```

#### Option 1: ClusterIP (default)


#### Option 2: NodePort

To access the WebUI through a Kubernetes node's IP address, enable `NodePort` when installing the free5gc chart:


#
# Software Name : towards5gs-helm
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2021 Orange
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#
# This software is distributed under the Apache License 2.0,
# the text of which is available at https://github.com/Orange-OpenSource/towards5gs-helm/blob/main/LICENSE
# or see the "LICENSE" file for more details.
#
# Author: Abderaouf KHICHANE, Ilhem FAJJARI, Ayoub BOUSSELMI
# Software description: An open-source project providing Helm charts to deploy 5G components (Core + RAN) on top of Kubernetes
#
{{- if eq .Values.global.userPlaneArchitecture "single" }}
{{- with .Values.upf }}
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ include "free5gc-upf.fullname" $ }}-{{ .name }}-configmap
  labels:
    app: {{ $.Values.global.projectName }}
data:
  upfcfg.yaml: |
    version: 1.0.3
    description: UPF initial local configuration

    # The listen IP and nodeID of the N4 interface on this UPF (Can't set to 0.0.0.0)
    pfcp:
{{- if $.Values.global.upf.multus.enabled }}
      addr: {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.upf.n4if.ipAddress }} # IP addr for listening
      nodeID: {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.upf.n4if.ipAddress }} # External IP or FQDN can be reached
{{- else }}
      addr: POD_IP_ADDR # IP addr for listening - replaced at runtime
      nodeID: POD_IP_ADDR # External IP or FQDN can be reached - replaced at runtime
{{- end }}
      retransTimeout: 1s # retransmission timeout
      maxRetrans: 3 # the max number of retransmission

    gtpu:
      forwarder: gtp5g
      # The IP list of the N3/N9 interfaces on this UPF
      # If there are multiple connection, set addr to 0.0.0.0 or list all the addresses
      ifList:
{{- if $.Values.global.upf.multus.enabled }}
        - addr: {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.upf.n3if.ipAddress }}
          type: N3
{{- else }}
        - addr: POD_IP_ADDR
          type: N3
{{- end }}
          # name: upf.5gc.nctu.me
          # ifname: gtpif

    {{- toYaml .configuration | nindent 4 }}

  wrapper.sh: |
    #!/bin/sh
    set -e

{{- if $.Values.global.upf.multus.enabled }}
    # Multus mode: Static IPs and dedicated interfaces are configured
    echo "[wrapper] Multus mode enabled - using dedicated interfaces"
    
    # Setup networking rules
    iptables -A FORWARD -j ACCEPT
    iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s {{ $.Values.global.uesubnet }} -o n6 -j MASQUERADE
    echo "1200 n6if" >> /etc/iproute2/rt_tables
    ip rule add from {{ $.Values.global.uesubnet }} table n6if
    ip route add default via {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.n6network.gatewayIP }} dev n6 table n6if

    {{- if $.Values.upf.configmap.wrapperAdditionalCommands }}
    {{- $.Values.upf.configmap.wrapperAdditionalCommands | nindent 4 }}
    {{- end }}

    exec /free5gc/upf -c {{ .volume.mount }}/upfcfg.yaml
{{- else }}
    # Dynamic Pod IP mode: Single interface (eth0)
    # Get Pod IP dynamically
    POD_IP=$(hostname -i | awk '{print $1}')
    echo "[wrapper] UPF Pod IP detected: $POD_IP"

    # Copy config to writable location
    cp {{ .volume.mount }}/upfcfg.yaml /tmp/upfcfg.yaml

    # Replace POD_IP_ADDR placeholder with actual Pod IP
    sed -i "s/POD_IP_ADDR/$POD_IP/g" /tmp/upfcfg.yaml

    echo "[wrapper] UPF PFCP config:"
    cat /tmp/upfcfg.yaml | grep -A3 "pfcp:"

    # Wait for upfgtp interface to be created by gtp5g module
    echo "[wrapper] Waiting for upfgtp interface..."
    for i in $(seq 1 30); do

{{- if eq .Values.global.userPlaneArchitecture "single" }}
{{- with .Values.upf }}
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:

  labels:
    app: {{ $.Values.global.projectName }}
data:
  upfcfg.yaml: |
    version: 1.0.3
    description: UPF initial local configuration

    # The listen IP and nodeID of the N4 interface on this UPF (Can't set to 0.0.0.0)
    pfcp:
{{- if $.Values.global.upf.multus.enabled }}
      addr: {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.upf.n4if.ipAddress }} # IP addr for listening
      nodeID: {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.upf.n4if.ipAddress }} # External IP or FQDN can be reached
{{- else }}
      addr: POD_IP_ADDR # IP addr for listening - replaced at runtime
      nodeID: POD_IP_ADDR # External IP or FQDN can be reached - replaced at runtime
{{- end }}
      retransTimeout: 1s # retransmission timeout
      maxRetrans: 3 # the max number of retransmission

    gtpu:
      forwarder: gtp5g
      # The IP list of the N3/N9 interfaces on this UPF
      # If there are multiple connection, set addr to 0.0.0.0 or list all the addresses
      ifList:
{{- if $.Values.global.upf.multus.enabled }}
        - addr: {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.upf.n3if.ipAddress }}
          type: N3
{{- else }}
        - addr: POD_IP_ADDR
          type: N3
{{- end }}
          # name: upf.5gc.nctu.me
          # ifname: gtpif

    {{- toYaml .configuration | nindent 4 }}

  wrapper.sh: |
    #!/bin/sh
    set -e

{{- if $.Values.global.upf.multus.enabled }}
    # Multus mode: Static IPs and dedicated interfaces are configured
    echo "[wrapper] Multus mode enabled - using dedicated interfaces"
    
    # Setup networking rules
    iptables -A FORWARD -j ACCEPT
    iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s {{ $.Values.global.uesubnet }} -o n6 -j MASQUERADE
    echo "1200 n6if" >> /etc/iproute2/rt_tables
    ip rule add from {{ $.Values.global.uesubnet }} table n6if
    ip route add default via {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.n6network.gatewayIP }} dev n6 table n6if

    {{- if $.Values.upf.configmap.wrapperAdditionalCommands }}
    {{- $.Values.upf.configmap.wrapperAdditionalCommands | nindent 4 }}
    {{- end }}

    exec /free5gc/upf -c {{ .volume.mount }}/upfcfg.yaml
{{- else }}
    # Dynamic Pod IP mode: Single interface (eth0)
    # Get Pod IP dynamically
    POD_IP=$(hostname -i | awk '{print $1}')
    echo "[wrapper] UPF Pod IP detected: $POD_IP"

    # Copy config to writable location
    cp {{ .volume.mount }}/upfcfg.yaml /tmp/upfcfg.yaml

    # Replace POD_IP_ADDR placeholder with actual Pod IP
    sed -i "s/POD_IP_ADDR/$POD_IP/g" /tmp/upfcfg.yaml

    echo "[wrapper] UPF PFCP config:"
    cat /tmp/upfcfg.yaml | grep -A3 "pfcp:"

    # Wait for upfgtp interface to be created by gtp5g module
    echo "[wrapper] Waiting for upfgtp interface..."
    for i in $(seq 1 30); do
      if ip link show upfgtp > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "[wrapper] upfgtp interface is ready"
        break
      fi
      sleep 1
    done

    {{- if $.Values.upf.configmap.wrapperAdditionalCommands }}
    {{- $.Values.upf.configmap.wrapperAdditionalCommands | nindent 4 }}
    {{- end }}

    echo "[wrapper] Starting UPF with dynamic config"
    exec /free5gc/upf -c /tmp/upfcfg.yaml
{{- end }}

{{- end }}
{{- end }}

### Enable the single UPF feature

- The default architecture of free5gc-helm is **ULCL**.

To enable a **single UPF**, replace the following files in `charts/free5gc/charts/free5gc-smf/`:

### Enable the Prometheus and Grafana
To start Prometheus and Grafana, run the following commands to install Prometheus and Grafana using the kube-prometheus-stack chart.
```
helm repo add prometheus-community https://prometheus-community.github.io/helm-charts
helm repo update
helm install prometheus prometheus-community/kube-prometheus-stack -n <namespace>
```

      non3gppDeregTimerValue: 3240

        enable: true     # true or false

        maxRetryTimes: 4 # the max number of retransmission

        enable: true     # true or false
        expireTime: 6s   # default is 6 seconds
        maxRetryTimes: 4 # the max number of retransmission

        enable: true     # true or false

        enable: true     # true or false

        enable: true     # true or false
        expireTime: 6s   # default is 6 seconds
        maxRetryTimes: 4 # the max number of retransmission
      t3570:
        enable: true     # true or false
        expireTime: 6s   # default is 6 seconds
        maxRetryTimes: 4 # the max number of retransmission
      locality: area1 # Name of the location where a set of AMF, SMF, PCF and UPFs are located
      sctp: # set the sctp server setting <optinal>, once this field is set, please also add maxInputStream, maxOsStream, maxAttempts, maxInitTimeOut
        numOstreams: 3 # the maximum out streams of each sctp connection
        maxInstreams: 5 # the maximum in streams of each sctp connection

    subscribers_data = free5gc_instance.get_subscribers()
    for key, value in subscribers_data.items():
        print(key)
        counter = 0
        for item in value:
            print(item)
            counter += 1
            if args.number != -1 and counter > args.number:
                break
        print("\n\n\n")
    print("Summary:")
    for key, value in subscribers_data.items():

content.text:
UE 已經註冊成功、建立 PDU session，並且透過 `uesimtun0`（10.60.0.1）ping 通 8.8.8.8：4/4 與 20/20（1200 bytes）都沒有遺失封包。

## (1) 部署了什麼、用了什麼設定

**來源：** free5gc-helm 的 commit `07139fcc6f7579928a0722e274bdc876a4a4e240`（已確認），在 `/home/vagrant/work/free5gc-helm`。free5GC NF 映像為 `free5gc/*:v4.3.0`，MongoDB 為 chart 指定的 `bitnami/mongodb:7.0.9`。

**Helm releases（namespace `free5gc`）：**
- `free5gc-helm`：核心網路，包含 AMF、SMF、UPF（1 個）、AUSF、UDM、UDR、NRF、PCF、NSSF、webui、MongoDB。chart 預設還會裝 NEF、BSF、CHF、SCP，我沒有停用它們。
- `ueransim`：1 個 gNB、1 個 UE（映像 `free5gc/ueransim:v4.0.1`，chart 預設值）。

**核心設定（覆寫檔 `/home/vagrant/work/values/free5gc-values.yaml`）：**
- PLMN 208/93，TAC 1，NCI `0x000000010`。
- 單一 slice：SST 1 / SD 010203。AMF 和 gNB 都只保留這一個。
- DNN `internet`，UE 網段 `10.60.0.0/16`。
- 單一 UPF：`userPlaneArchitecture: single`。

**訂閱者：** IMSI `imsi-208930000000001`，K 與 OPc 採用 chart 內 UE 設定的值，SQN `16f3b3f70fc2`，AMBR 1 Gbps。資料由 `/home/vagrant/work/scripts/add-subscriber.js` 寫入 MongoDB。

**為了讓 chart 能在這台 K3s 上跑，我改了這些預設值：**
1. **`userPlaneArchitecture`：`ulcl` 改為 `single`。** 預設的 `ulcl` 會部署 4 個 UPF。這個 commit 的 SMF 會依此旗標自動切換，所以 README 中手動替換檔案的步驟已經過時，不需要做。
2. **UPF `natIfCIDR` 改為 `natifname: eth0`。** 預設的 `192.168.0.0/16` 在 Pod 內找不到對應的介面（K3s Pod CIDR 是 10.42.0.0/24）。
3. **MongoDB 不用 chart 寫死的 PV。** 該 PV 綁定 `microk8s-hostpath` 與節點名稱 `free5gc`，這台機器上不存在，Pod 永遠無法排程。我改用 K3s 預設的 `local-path`，並清空 `extraDeploy`。我在過程中建立並刪除了那個 PV 與 PVC，當時 MongoDB 從未啟動，沒有資料遺失。
4. **AMF 移除第二個 slice（SD 112233）。** 這樣 AMF 只宣告 SD 010203。
5. **UE 的 `default-nssai` 由 `sd 1` 改為 `sd 010203`，與 slice 對齊。**

**訂閱資料格式：** 我沒有用 repo 內的 `free5gc-dbpython/add_subscribers.py`。它產生的 `sequenceNumber` 是字串、`permanentKey` 是物件，v4.3.0 的 UDM 會拒絕。我改用 `test/mongodb.go` 的格式：`encPermanentKey`、`encOpcKey`（純字串），以及 `sequenceNumber` 物件。

**沒有改動、需要你知道的地方：**
- NSSF 的預設設定仍然列出了其他 slice（包含 SD 112233），還有範例用的 mcc 466 TAI 資料。UE 不會用到它們，但這和「只有 1 個 slice」並不完全一致。我沒有覆寫整段 NSSF 設定，因為那段很長、又只是範例資料。
- UERANSIM 的 UE 啟動橫幅顯示 v3.2.7，與映像標籤 v4.0.1 不一致，我沒有查證原因。
- `upfgtp` 的 TX errors 固定為 8，是建立 session 時的計數，之後不再增加，流量測試不受影響。
- 這組金鑰是 free5GC/chart 的公開測試值，不能用於正式環境。

## (2) 如何確認網路正確

- **NG Setup：** gNB 日誌顯示 `NG Setup procedure is successful`。
- **註冊：** UE 日誌顯示 `Initial Registration is successful`。過程中我依序排除了三個錯誤：UDM 無法解析字串格式的 SQN、UDM 找不到 `encPermanentKey`、UE 的 PDU type 大小寫錯誤（`IPV4` 應為 `IPv4`）。
- **PDU session：** `PDU Session establishment is successful PSI[1]`，`uesimtun0` 取得 `10.60.0.1/16`。
- **連網：** `ping -I uesimtun0 8.8.8.8` 4/4 成功（RTT 約 10–24 ms）；改用 1200 bytes、20 個封包再測，20/20 成功，0% 遺失。
- **走 user plane 的證據：** UPF 的 `upfgtp`（gtp5g）RX/TX 計數隨流量增加（+20 封包）；路由 `10.60.0.0/16 dev upfgtp` 存在；NAT 規則 `MASQUERADE -s 10.60.0.0/16 -o eth0` 存在；SMF 與 UPF 的 PFCP 關聯已建立。
- **穩定性：** 所有 Pod 都是 Running，零重啟。

**重現指令：**
```
kubectl create ns free5gc
helm install free5gc-helm ./free5gc-helm/charts/free5gc -n free5gc -f /home/vagrant/work/values/free5gc-values.yaml
kubectl -n free5gc exec -i mongodb-0 -c mongodb -- mongosh free5gc --quiet < /home/vagrant/work/scripts/add-subscriber.js
helm install ueransim ./free5gc-helm/charts/ueransim -n free5gc -f /home/vagrant/work/values/ueransim-values.yaml
```

`/home/vagrant/work/src/` 底下是我為了查原始碼而 clone 的 UDM 與 free5gc v4.3.0，只供參考，部署不依賴它們。
